incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED @oncall - High error rate observed for runtime-api (text generation) in us-east-1. Spike started ~1839456600. Error class: 429 + occasional 504. Incident ID: INC-20260314-0912
emma: ack, I'm live on this. Pulling up dashboards now.
raj: on it with infra. I'm seeing a KV cache miss storm and queuing on the tokenizer workers, causing backpressure into the fronting layer. 429s look like internal soft-throttles cascading.
emma: quick customer impact check: cs-lead, do we have customers calling out issues?
cs-lead: we have two high-tier customers reporting timeouts in the last 5m. No broad outage reported in support yet, but their SDKs are spiking retries.
sofia: tagging in for handoff in 10m. If we need to escalate network/infra I'll join.
emma: mitigation plan proposal (short-term): 1) apply soft global ingress shaping (-30% burst allowance) to reduce tail contention, 2) temporarily tighten per-api-key burst quotas for unknown clients, 3) exempt enterprise SLA customers from the new tighter burst cap, 4) enable fallback to smaller model variant for the slowest requests, 5) ask SDK teams to recommend immediate client-side changes (backoff & idempotency).
raj: agree. Pushing a traffic-shaper rule to edge now: rate-limit key-level burst=200 -> 140 for non-exempt keys. Will monitor qlen.
emma: tony, can you push a quick config to disable streaming attachments for non-SLA customers? It's a nonessential feature that's increasing request size.
tony: done. Disabled streaming for flags: "streaming:non-sla". Took effect in config at 1839456902.
sdk-ops: quick note for SDKs — we should publish a short advisory to recommend: exponential backoff with jitter, respect Retry-After, add Idempotency-Key header for non-idempotent calls. I'll prepare snippet and doc blurb, can we get this out within 15m?
emma: yes, do it. Put a short post in docs + release a micro-patch to the JS/py clients with default backoff params.
sdk-ops: posting recommended guidance (paste):
```
# Recommended retry policy (client-side)
# - On 429: respect Retry-After if present, otherwise retry with exponential backoff
# - On 5xx (502/503/504): retry with exponential backoff
# - On 4xx other than 429: do not retry

initial_delay_ms = 200
max_delay_ms = 10000
factor = 2.0
jitter_fraction = 0.5

# pseudocode
attempt = 0
while attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS:
    resp = call_api()
    if resp.status == 200: break
    if resp.status == 429 and resp.headers.get('Retry-After'):
        sleep(parse_retry_after(resp.headers['Retry-After']))
    elif resp.status in [429, 502, 503, 504]:
        delay = min(max_delay_ms, initial_delay_ms * (factor ** attempt))
        jitter = random.uniform(-jitter_fraction*delay, jitter_fraction*delay)
        sleep(delay + jitter)
    else:
        raise resp
    attempt += 1
```
Also: add header `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` for operations that create resources (POSTs) so server-side dedup works.
sofia: recommend MAX_ATTEMPTS=6 for most SDK calls. That keeps worst-case client-side delay bounded.
raj: after shaping applied qlen dropped by ~45% in 30s, 429 rate down ~60%. Still seeing some 504s from tokenizer phase; I've scaled tokenizer pool +1 node to help.
cs-lead: notifying impacted customers now with the above mitigation + guidance: "If you see 429s, update SDKs to latest patch which includes improved backoff; for critical requests use Idempotency-Key or request temporary quota uplift via support."
emma: can we do temporary quota uplifts for the two customers who reported issues? We should grant targeted uplift to avoid further retries.
sofia: yes, I've applied a 2x temporary quota to those two enterprise keys, expires in 2 hours. Documented in the incident log.
emma: great. tony, can you prepare a one-paragraph status for external comms and include the SDK guidance link? Keep it accurate: mitigation in place, working on root cause, customers with issues are being assisted.
tony: drafting now. Will post to status page and CS thread.
sdk-ops: quick SDK PR plan: - bump default backoff settings, - log when Idempotency-Key is missing for create calls (warn only), - add opt-in stricter request coalescing for embeddings (v0.14.3). Canary release in 20m to 5% of clients.
emma: please tag me on the canary metrics dashboard. We'll look for retry rates and error class reductions.
raj: marking this as partial mitigation. Continuing root cause: tokenization hot-spot from a specific model variant when sequence lengths exceed 2048. Long term: need KV cache improvements and model variant routing.
sofia: I'm taking over monitoring for next shift. Handing off now to @sofia for overnight oversight. Emma -> Raj: any open actions for infra?
emma: Raj to follow up on cache changes, Sofia to watch canary, SDK to ship patch, CS to notify customers. I'll run postmortem if we stabilize.
sofia: ack. I'll add the action items to the incident board.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260314-0912 status updated: mitigated -> partial. Notifications: status page pending external message by 1839457200.
emma: thanks team. If anything spikes again, re-page. :white_check_mark:"
